messages.subject: BPA workshop Patuxent 8-12 July 2013
messages.body_plain:
Dear colleagues,

Attached is the announcement for another Bayesian Population Analysis workshop, to be held at the Patuxent Wildlife Research Center from 8-12 July 2013. Please note the possibility to apply for a Jim Nichols Travel Award to cover all the costs of attending the workshop (bottom of announcement).
Happy holidays.

Kind regards  --  Marc
